remediation.suggestion: Vendor the required shared guidance into this skill or replace ../ references with reviewed in-package references.

remediation.issue: The skill encourages local altllm command execution for cloud operations.
remediation.suggestion: Document required confirmations, allowed command forms, and safeguards before launching, stopping, deleting, or renewing VMs.

content.value_statement: Cloud Claw work spans deployment launch, VM lifecycle actions, logs, renewals, and dashboard access. This skill routes users to focused workflows and local altllm commands.
actual_capabilities: Routes mixed Cloud Claw requests to launch or VM management workflows.
Identifies when to use cloud-claw-launch-agent for new deployments.
Identifies when to use cloud-claw-manage-vm for existing VM operations.
Covers start, stop, restart, renew, auto-renew, delete, logs, and dashboard tasks.
Points agents toward user-facing API routes instead of low-level build scripts.
limitations: Requires local altllm cloud-claw commands to be available in the environment.
Depends on sibling shared documentation that may not be packaged with the skill.
Does not provide standalone Cloud Claw API implementation details.
Cloud resource changes may need user confirmation before execution.

use_cases.title: Launch A New Cloud VM
use_cases.description: Guide a user through selecting an OpenClaw, PicoClaw, or Ottie deployment and preparing launch inputs.

use_cases.title: Operate Existing Deployments
use_cases.description: Help an operator inspect, start, stop, restart, renew, or delete Cloud Claw VMs through the supported workflow.

use_cases.title: Review Cloud Claw Coverage
use_cases.description: Map user requests to supported Cloud Claw commands, API routes, and source ownership notes.

prompt_templates.title: Start A Cloud Claw Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $cloud-claw to help me choose the right Cloud Claw workflow for my deployment or VM management task.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare A New Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $cloud-claw to prepare a new OpenClaw deployment. Check prerequisites and list the launch details you need from me.

prompt_templates.title: Manage A Running VM
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for existing resource operations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $cloud-claw to inspect my existing Cloud Claw VMs and explain safe options for logs, restart, renewal, and dashboard access.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Launch And Operations
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $cloud-claw to plan a Cloud Claw launch, then define the follow-up lifecycle, renewal, logging, and dashboard management steps.

output_examples.input: I need to launch an OpenClaw VM and then monitor it.
output_examples.output: The skill would route launch preparation to the deployment workflow, then switch to VM management for logs and dashboard access.

output_examples.input: Show me what I can do with my existing Cloud Claw deployment.
output_examples.output: The skill would identify management actions such as list, inspect, start, stop, restart, renew, auto-renew, delete, logs, and dashboard access.

output_examples.input: Should I use raw HTTP routes for this Cloud Claw action?
output_examples.output: The skill would prefer supported local altllm cloud-claw commands and keep the workflow aligned with user-facing API routes.

best_practices: Confirm the target VM and intended action before running any command that changes resources.
Use the focused launch or management workflow when the request stays within one domain.
Stay on user-facing Cloud Claw API routes unless the user explicitly requests lower-level implementation work.
anti_patterns: Do not treat low-level GCP build or image scripts as the default user workflow.
Do not use ad-hoc raw HTTP when a supported local Cloud Claw command is available.
Do not run destructive VM actions without clear user confirmation.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It coordinates Cloud Claw deployment launch and VM management workflows.

faq.question: Which focused skills does it reference?
faq.answer: It references cloud-claw-launch-agent for new deployments and cloud-claw-manage-vm for existing VMs.

faq.question: What VM actions are covered?
faq.answer: The referenced management workflow covers list, inspect, start, stop, restart, renew, auto-renew, delete, logs, and dashboard tasks.

faq.question: Does it make cloud changes by itself?
faq.answer: No. It guides an agent toward local commands, and sensitive actions should require user confirmation.

faq.question: Does it support raw API development?
faq.answer: It prefers user-facing Cloud Claw commands and routes over raw HTTP or low-level infrastructure scripts.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: The environment needs the local altllm cloud-claw commands and any referenced Cloud Claw guidance files.
